resources.string: Auto-grouped folders · Long-press to merge or rename. Original files stay untouched.
%1$d original folders · Tap to preview, long-press to select.
Cannot read the local folder. Check the storage directory and permission, then retry.
No matching author folders in local.
No matching supported archives or image directories.
Open this exact work in the reader and long-press a page to set its cover. Directory and child entries have independent covers and tags.
Numbering follows selection order. Arrows change collection reading order; the first item supplies the automatic title and default cover.
Checked tags apply to all selected works; a dash means some works. Uncheck to remove. Untouched mixed tags are preserved.
Select at most 1000 works per operation. Narrow the search or add in batches.
Operation failed. Check folder access and category availability, then retry. Successfully added works are kept; retrying the same selection will not duplicate them.
Library entries and category changes saved.
Restore automatic grouping for the selected manual groups. No comic files or library entries will be removed.
Only the displayed directory is merged or renamed. Rules are saved; files, existing works and reading order stay unchanged.
Cannot load current categories. Retry before saving.

Create a normal backup in More → Data and storage and include Library, Chapters and Categories. Author groups and work directories (including directories not in the library), names, member order and reader-page cover references are preserved without App settings. Library memberships, tags and progress use normal backup fields. Comics and gallery cover caches are not included. Keep the original relative paths and grant storage access after restoring.
Remove fully covered originals when adding directory (keep files)

Only originals fully covered by this selection are removed from all library categories. Partially selected originals stay. Files, chapters and reading records are not deleted. The new collection uses your selected categories.
Only organizes the local manager. This does not add anything to the library or change existing tags. Enter the new directory to add it or its individual works independently.
%1$d works · each has independent library entries and tags
Enter the reader, choose any chapter and long-press a page to set the directory cover. This does not change child work covers; the directory does not need to be in the library.
Use first page as directory cover
Directory cover saved. Child work cover unchanged.
No named tags (Default when in library)
No matching tags. Create categories in the library first if needed.
